text:
liz: Quick heads-up — on v3-reranker bringup: NDCG +1.2% but MRR -6% on short queries (<=6 tokens). Observed on quantized 4-bit PTQ run across shortq-10k.

darren: hmm. Is this on quantized model or fp16?

liz: Quant 4-bit PTQ (dynquant). Staging eval across 10k queries.

noah: Did you check candidate ordering? Sometimes priming causes early candidates to get stronger signals.

liz: Good call — our eval priming is sequential: we append priming text once per query before ranking all candidates. We should compare per-candidate priming (prime each candidate separately) vs single-sequence priming.

maria: That's interesting. Could also be a KV cache truncation in quant path — priming window trimmed to 64 tokens for speed.

liz: Repro plan: run eval with --priming-mode={sequential,per-candidate} and --priming-window={64,256,1024}. Also toggle --disable-kv-truncation.

darren: Add candidate-shuffle ablation (to rule out position bias).

noah: Share example command.

liz: paste command
```
python rerank_eval.py --model=redwood/ranker-v3-4bit --dataset=shortq-10k 
  --priming-mode=sequential --priming-window=64 --disable-kv-truncation=false 
  --shuffle-candidates=false --output=run1.json
```

maria: If perf is tied to priming-window, we should test reduced priming text (shorter priming) too.

liz: Quick log from current run (snipped):
```
NDCG@10: 0.842 (+1.2%)
MRR@5: 0.512 (-6.3%)
mean_query_len: 4.1
priming_tokens: 92
avg_kv_cache_len: 256 -> truncated to 64 at step 3
```

darren: That avg_kv_cache_len line looks like our issue — cache truncated at step 3 causing later candidate reps to lose context.

noah: Can we try per-candidate priming with disable-kv-truncation=true and compare?

liz: I'll run it now, will post results in thread. /cc @maria

maria: I'll spin a small run with candidate-shuffle+no-truncation to check position bias.

eval-bot: Scheduled job 3400010100 started: rerank_eval (shortq-10k, model=ranker-v3-4bit, priming=per-candidate, window=1024)

liz: Thanks. If this reproduces, follow-ups: (1) tune packer to preserve priming prefix in KVC (2) update quant kernel to avoid early evictions (3) add priming-mode to model config

darren: Also add a regression test in CI comparing MRR on shortq to a tolerance.

noah: If it's not kv, check tokenization differences for short queries — sometimes subtokenization cause priming overlap.

liz: Agreed. I'll include tokenizer parity snapshot in runs.

maria: ping when results posted.

eval-bot: Completed job 3400010205: NDCG@10=0.840 (+0.9%), MRR@5=0.528 (-2.9%)

liz: Interesting — per-candidate + no-trunc improved MRR (down only 2.9%). Looks like both priming-mode and truncation matter.

darren: Ok plan: small PR for config change to set priming-window=256 and add per-candidate default for short queries; add CI check. I'll draft PR.

liz: Thanks everyone. Will attach run artifacts to the ticket #RERANK-537.
